title: "M6 - Standalone Module"

## Purpose

This page summarizes the standalone technical scope of M6 - Recommendation Systems.

## Technical Scope

- Training data extraction from Wikipedia dumps in current implementation
- Current benchmark indicates recall@1000 around 72 percent in tested setup
- Designed for research and experimentation use cases
- Adaptable to other domains with new training datasets
- Licensed under Apache 2.0 according to module notes

## Run Guidance

Run service via project README commands and query through REST or MCP endpoints

## Expected Outcome

A reproducible execution path suitable for technical validation, demonstrations, and staged integration into platform workflows.
